audit_scope: Current-source readiness for the new E924 RGBNT201 prepare/M0 only
summary: No confirmed current-source blocker for bounded prepare/M0. New M0 ownership diagnostics are reachable; runtime activity, equality, AMP and cost facts remain unexecuted. Generic M0_PASS alone is not complete plan acceptance.

A_provenance.details: Dataset labels/cameras define legal training relations; the sensitivity and positive-margin support are explicitly model-derived proxies. Inference consumes no identity labels. Actual CLI-selected files and batch support are pending.

B_normalization.details: L2/softmax, support-count averaging and fixed 256 VJP unscaling are model/proxy operations. No new retrieval score is self-normalized; the reused camera AP averages real-label ranked precision.

C_existence_status.details: The current plan explicitly says no execution; all four E924 milestones are TODO. Versioned plans are documents, not result receipts. No new-stage result or completed M0 is attested.

D_actual_call_path.details: Static configure/build tracing resolves the evidence constructor and type guard to GlobalConditionedEvidence and the wrapper to GlobalTaskRoleHeads. CURRENT_MODEL is assigned to the built training model. M0 isolation recomputes the fused author loss from existing output heads via run_role_input_detach.loss_values, not the combined loss and not recursion. Optimizer/state source paths are compatible. Actual execution remains pending.

E_scope_cost.details: Only new RGBNT201 prepare/eight-step M0 per arm is source-ready. Both arms use one exposure VJP per training forward and the same active-mask rule. M0 additionally invokes one ownership-isolation autograd.grad and recomputes losses from existing head outputs, in both arms; formal training omits it. Timing, actual activity, capacity and AMP adequacy are untested.

classification.labels_and_future_retrieval: real_gt source lineage; no new evaluated score

F_classification.details: The target includes anchor, positive and negative effects. Pre-CNN masking and softmax exclusion block selected local reads, but contextualized patches, global-conditioned queries and global residual remain. No causal, semantic-disjointness, novelty or efficacy guarantee follows.

required_runtime_facts.fact: Bind actual protocol/public-CLIP/Signal source/config/module bytes, native B64/K8 and camera/label provenance. Numerically verify original-semantic and paired parameter/buffer equality, optimizer ownership and initial-state receipts.

Each arm must have eight actual effective M0 updates and at least one supported, active, masked step. Check excluded_patches equals 32 times active_sample_modalities and retain zero-support steps. Generic inherited M0_PASS does not itself assert this new activity criterion.

Observe the new per-step ownership assertions and recorded counts actually passing: absent parameter .grad after exposure VJP, and no fused-author-task gradient path to shared_global or any intended trainable backbone parameter. Preserve ordinary backward finite-gradient/effective-update results. FP32 target arithmetic and scale256 do not certify FP32-equivalent upstream AMP sensitivity/coverage/ranking.

Execute strict checkpoint-state reload and label-free/unmasked inference comparison. Existing M0 checks two source samples at atol=rtol=1e-5, not bitwise output equality or full-gallery parity. Mask/generator are transient; current inference does not consume them and exact training resumption is not claimed.

Measure actual two-card AMP cost/peak memory and disk reserve against new artifacts. M0 includes extra isolation work; its aggregate timing is not a direct formal-train per-step estimate. Historical B16/eval/FP32 timing and stale free-space observations establish neither capacity nor current admission.

nonblocking_source_limits.detail: Activity/exclusion counts are recorded, but inherited M0_PASS does not assert at least one active supported masking step. The explicit plan requirement must be assessed from real receipts before formal training.
Strict replacement-role state loading supports zero-added-parameter compatibility, not an executed full original-semantic/paired equality witness.

superseded_observations.detail: The initial source lacked explicit ownership diagnostics. Current source adds reachable M0-only .grad absence and fused-task isolation assertions. Any earlier suggestion that these diagnostics are absent is superseded. No stale source verdict file was emitted.

boundaries.external_runtime_source: The CLI-selected live Signal root was not supplied/inspected remotely. Local mirrors and the historical snapshot are not attestation of next live imports; historical signal_meta_arch.py line102 moves camera IDs to embedding device.
boundaries.future_training: No fifty-epoch, performance, novelty, causal, semantic-disjointness or goal-completion approval. The future trainer selects official per-epoch mAP; selection-independent generalization is not certified.
boundaries.context_isolation: Not fully context-isolated: mandatory session-note reads occurred and combined outputs were partly truncated. No note used as runtime evidence; MEMORY.md not read.
